name: ai.zensation/zenbrain
title: ZenBrain Memory
description: Seven-layer agent memory: episodic, semantic, procedural and core. Local SQLite, no account.

environmentVariables.name: ZENBRAIN_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the SQLite file that holds the memory. Use ':memory:' for a store that is discarded when the process exits.

environmentVariables.name: ZENBRAIN_CONTEXTS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated context domains for cross-context memory.
